description: esy-osmfilter reads OpenStreetMap PBF files and extracts objects through reusable filtering stages. The German Aerospace Center Institute of Networked Energy Systems developed it in the SciGRID_gas context. The Python library first narrows nodes, ways and relations, then applies more specific inclusion and exclusion rules and exports dictionaries or GeoJSON. Its own example extracts pipelines from Liechtenstein. Geographic extent and reference date follow the chosen OSM extract; the library does not supply a uniform global snapshot. It can prepare gas, pipeline and other infrastructure-network inputs for simulation. Source and the versioned archive are free under GPL-3.0-or-later, while OSM data keep their separate terms. The tool complements model-building workflows that need selected tagged assets. A limitation is that the inspected README says GeoJSON export is not implemented for relations, and usable networks still depend on mapping completeness and tag choices. No PBF file was downloaded or extraction performed.
